# Selected game-cry recordings

The current companion calls use the following two game recordings. Audio bytes are unmodified; application playback and gain are separate behavior.

- **Vaporeon** — [original recording](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeAPI/cries/main/cries/pokemon/latest/134.ogg), Pokémon ID 134.
- **Articuno** — [original recording](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeAPI/cries/main/cries/pokemon/latest/144.ogg), Pokémon ID 144.

Source collection: [PokéAPI cries repository](https://github.com/PokeAPI/cries), documented by [PokéAPI’s cries API](https://pokeapi.co/docs/v2#pokemon). The repository credits Pokémon Showdown, Veekun and The Sounds Resource as upstream collection sources. These are community-hosted game recordings, not generated voices.

Four other companions use the separately credited source-labeled anime calls. Snorlax is silent. Calls are optional; no recording is required to reach portfolio content.

The recordings are retained at the owner’s request for review before publishing. Public repository access does not establish rightsholder permission for every public or commercial redistribution. No independent rights clearance or official affiliation is claimed.
